samples.title: Demo S, Overview lens
samples.summary: The whole small demo organisation as the app opens it: folders, projects, the Shared VPC with its networks and every resource, with arrows for the references.

samples.title: Demo M, Overview lens
samples.summary: The medium demo organisation as the app opens it: three business units of folders, their projects collapsed into chips that count what they hold.

samples.title: Demo M, Networking lens, focused on the production Shared VPC
samples.summary: The production Shared VPC of demo M and the projects attached to it: load balancers, addresses, Cloud Interconnect and VPN, with the host project’s network.
